hni_signals: Consultant Paediatric Cardiologist at CARE Hospitals Banjara Hills - paediatric cardiology is a scarce super-specialty (only a few dozen FNB-qualified paediatric cardiologists practise in Telangana). Full super-specialty stack: MBBS, DCH, DNB (Paediatrics), FNB (Paediatric Cardiology). Interventional-capable: performs ASD/VSD/PDA device closures, balloon pulmonary and aortic valvuloplasty and diagnostic cardiac catheterization, plus foetal, neonatal and transoesophageal echo - a premium, high-value procedural mix. Career track shows movement between two major groups: FNB Paediatric Cardiology at CARE Hospitals (2016-2018), Consultant Paediatric Cardiologist at CARE (2018-2019), then Consultant Paediatric Cardiologist at Rainbow Children's Heart Institute (2019-2021), and now back at CARE Banjara Hills. Multilingual practice (English, Hindi, Telugu, Marathi). No ownership, directorship or HOD title found.
